episodes.synopsis: The Flying House transports back from the 20th century to 1st century Judea. The episode narrates the story of the birth of John the Baptist.
episodes.title: Blast Off For The Past

episodes.synopsis: In Bethlehem, at the manger, the kids witness the birth of Jesus.
episodes.title: Star-Spangled Night

episodes.synopsis: At the Temple in Jerusalem, the kids witness the finding of the lost 12-year-old Jesus by Mary and Joseph.
episodes.title: Lost And Found In Time

episodes.synopsis: On the Jordan River, the kids witness the baptism of Jesus by John the Baptist.
episodes.title: Voice In The Wilderness

episodes.synopsis: In the wilderness, the kids witness the temptation of Jesus.
episodes.title: Speak Of The Devil

episodes.synopsis: In Capernaum, the kids witness Jesus calling Matthew, the tax collector, to be his disciple.
episodes.title: All That Glitters

episodes.synopsis: In Capernaum, the kids witness Jesus healing the centurion's servant.
episodes.title: Military secrets

episodes.synopsis: In Machaerus, the kids witness the execution and death of John the Baptist.
episodes.title: The Prize That Was Won And Lost

episodes.synopsis: In Capernaum, the kids witness Jesus raising Jairus' daughter from dead to life.
episodes.title: Another life

episodes.synopsis: At the Sea of Galilee, the kids witness Jesus feeding the 5,000 people by multiplying five loaves and two fishes.
episodes.title: The Runaway

episodes.synopsis: The kids listen to Jesus telling the parables of the Good Samaritan and the Unforgiving Servant.
episodes.title: Neighbors

episodes.synopsis: The kids listen to Jesus telling the parables of the Rich Fool and the Prodigal Son.
episodes.title: Poor Little Rich Man

episodes.synopsis: The kids witness the Twelve Apostles arguing who among them is the greatest.
episodes.title: The greatest

episodes.synopsis: In Bethany, the kids witness Jesus at the home of Martha and Mary and Jesus raising Martha's and Mary's brother Lazarus from dead to life.
episodes.title: Back from the grave

episodes.synopsis: The Last Supper and the betrayal of Judas Iscariot
episodes.title: Betrayed

episodes.synopsis: Jesus' trials between Caiaphas, Herod and POntius Pilate
episodes.title: Who's In Charge

episodes.synopsis: Jesus is scourged at the pillars and put with a crown of thorns; Pilate frees Barabbas and sentenced Jesus to death by crucifixion.
episodes.title: The Crown of Thorns

episodes.synopsis: Jesus carries his cross towards Golgotha and Simon the Cyrene helps him during the process. Jesus dies on the cross.
episodes.title: Golgotha

episodes.synopsis: The Resurrection of Jesus
episodes.title: The Empty Tomb

episodes.synopsis: Jesus appears as himself to two of his disciples in the road towards Emmaus. The apostles catch lots of fish with the help of the risen Christ. Jesus asked Peter thrice, "Do you love me?" and the Ascension of Jesus into Heaven.
episodes.title: With You Always

episodes.synopsis: Peter follows the angel on a prison escape.
episodes.title: The Prison Break

episodes.synopsis: King Herod dies.
episodes.title: Good Riddance

episodes.synopsis: Follow Saul of Tarsus from the death of Stephen to his conversion from a persecutor of Christians to a follower of Christ with a new name, Paul, the apostle to the Gentiles.
episodes.title: The Building Light

episodes.synopsis: Paul preaches the word of God in Macedonia and deliver a woman from an evil spirit. Paul and Silas are flogged in public and placed in prison. A severe earthquake happened while they are in prison. The Roman officials released them from prison.
episodes.title: Bound & Rebound

episodes.synopsis: Paul interferes in a mob and helps a man get justice
episodes.title: Tender Grapes

episodes.synopsis: Paul's travel is delayed as he is shipwrecked on the island of Malta.
episodes.title: Shipwrecked

episodes.synopsis: While shipwrecked, Paul is bitten by a snake but does not die. Later God uses him to heal a young girl.
episodes.title: Snake Bite

episodes.synopsis: The story of Onesimus, the slave of Philemon
episodes.title: Heartbreak

episodes.synopsis: Paul writes Philemon to take back Onesimus, who is baptized and converted as a follower of Christ. The Flying House finally returns to the 20th century after its treks through the times of Ancient Israel
episodes.title: Homeward Bound
